en.title: Hellfire of Rusted Iron, Destiny of the Twin Eyes
en.premise: Nagi is a swordsman living in solitude, haunted by the loss of the twin brother he once clashed blades with. But the dead do not always rest; Nagi discovers that his brother now reigns as the King of the "Steel-Shell Oni," monstrous aberrations powered by steam-engine hearts. Driven by the pride of a samurai, Nagi embarks on a journey to slay the kin who has become a cold machine of steel. A single strike through the silence will purify this hell of blood and steam.

zh.title: 铁锈之业火，双眸之宿命
zh.premise: 剑客凪在与双胞胎兄长的一场生死决斗后失去了对方，从此孤独地生活着。然而，他惊觉本应死去的兄长，如今竟成为了拥有蒸汽机之心的异形怪物——“钢壳鬼”之王。怀揣着武士的骄傲，为了斩杀那个已化为冰冷钢铁之躯的至亲，他踏上了旅程。撕裂寂静的一击，将净化这片血与蒸汽的地狱。
